takeaway.text: Sessions live 30 days with no rotation

blocks.title: Main risk
blocks.text: Session lifetime is 30 days with no rotation
blocks.next: Rotate session id on privilege change; cap lifetime at 7 days

actions.label: Add session rotation
actions.prompt: Implement session id rotation on login and privilege change, and cap session lifetime at 7 days.

detail.markdown: `POST /login` hits the API, which delegates to either the password verifier (argon2id) or the OAuth callback handler. Both produce a `Session` row and the API answers with a signed, `HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Lax` cookie. OAuth access tokens stay server-side. The weak point is lifetime: sessions are valid for 30 days and the id is never rotated, so a stolen cookie stays valid for a month.
